question: Related Questions Q. a-o-a I had a dream about my uncle around a year later after his death were I see my self praying in the front row of a Friday prayer with all levels of people gathered. From physical description I see him in white cloths, well built in muscle, happy looking, with a black sheet covering his left side and stuff like kajal, topi, small beard, white skin even if he was a bit brown before death. I feel like everything isn?t right, as if I have been shown this dream to take care of his family. The first thought I had when I awake from the dream was marrying his daughter who I haven?t seen yet. What should be done, and what from your knowledge this dream really means? I was told by my parents that they are converting to chiasm and they are so young, I am in my 20ties and am not strong enough to be trusted by them. I feel really worried.
